title: Add watchdog to clear xDrip+ cache automatically at programmable intervals
body: Every once in a while my system fails receiving data from the G5 sensor. The failure mode continues until the xDrip+ app cache is cleared. Changes in the advanced bluetooth and collector service settings and/or restarting the phone do not seem to resolve the issue, but clearing the xDrip+ app cache resolves the issue, restores correct operation and does not require that I restart the phone. How difficult would it be to add an automatic xDrip cache cleaning routine to the "aggressive service restarts" option ? For now I try to setup a tasker app service to automatically clear the cache, but it would be nice if this function would be integrated within xDrip+. Thanks
